candidates.title: Building agentic workflows with SageMaker AI and Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: Learn how to combine OpenAI-compatible endpoints on Amazon SageMaker AI with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtime to build a multi-agent workflow where each specialized agent uses the model best suited to its job. This post also shows how to get token-level observability from SageMaker endpoints that Strands Agents does not instrument by default.

candidates.title: OpenAI introduces ‘Ultrafast,’ a new mode that makes GPT-5.6 Sol work at 14x the speed
candidates.summary: OpenAI is launching a preview of a sped up version of its latest, most powerful model, in an effort to court enterprise users.

candidates.title: Monitor on-premises and multi-cloud AI agents with AgentCore Observability
candidates.summary: Set up Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Observability for AI agents running outside AWS: on-premises, on GCP, on Azure, or on developer machines. This walkthrough uses the AWS Distro for OpenTelemetry (ADOT) and IAM credentials to route session traces, span metrics, and token usage to the same AgentCore Observability dashboard.

candidates.title: Bring your spreadsheet data to life with Sheets canvas
candidates.summary: Sheets canvas turns data into interactive dashboards, custom study trackers, seating charts, and more, all with a simple prompt.
